text: Додаток цікавий, навіть би витратилась на Преіум але дуже не вистачає української мови.
author: Оксана Бойко

text: It's really nice app, but if it's possible, please add recognition of Cyrillic fonts 🙏🏻 Some letters are replaced by symbols. And if I want to write a note, it doesn't even possible to save it if it's written in Cyrillic.
author: Olena (etapoid)
developer_reply: Thanks for providing this feedback! We'll look into this issue for you and make sure all journaling features are compatible with Cyrillic font characters!
